chapter_note: A compact five-fold classification of the works of visible fire. Apart from a brief dialogue-attribution incipit, the chapter is continuous systematic teaching: numbered structure, impersonal explanatory voice, and correspondential registers (separation into components; taste/aroma/heat/light) without ecclesial or NT overlay.

paragraphs.core_text: This fire, which burns and is apparent today in the world, it does five works.
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed dialogue/frame attribution: “Once more he speaks:” (a Kephalaia-style editorial incipit).
paragraphs.temporal_note: Mixed because the opening attribution (“he speaks”) is a later hagiographic/frame device; the remaining sentence launches a numbered five-work schema in an impersonal, classificatory mode characteristic of the core.

paragraphs.core_text: The first work that it does is this: It incinerates and burns wood, and everything that shall be placed upon it.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Core: first item in a numbered five-fold natural/cosmological exposition; descriptive rather than hortatory, with no institutional or citation markers.

paragraphs.core_text: The second: It separates four aspects of the wood, which are these: fire and light, ash and smoke.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Core: systematic ‘separates…four aspects’ analysis (process-mechanics and internal decomposition) typical of the older explanatory layer.

paragraphs.core_text: The third: It gives a taste and an {aroma} to whatever will be cooked on it. It also gives heat and cheer to whoever will be close to it.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Core: correspondential sensory/affective registers (taste/aroma/heat/cheer) treated as intrinsic effects of the element, not applied to contemporary institutions.

paragraphs.core_text: The fourth work that [it] does: All craftsmen shall work the utensils that they will fabricate in it.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Core: continues the five-work schema; ‘craftsmen/utensils’ remains an impersonal account of fire’s function in the world, not a pastoral address.

paragraphs.core_text: The fifth: It shall display light, and the people see by [it].
paragraphs.temporal_note: Core: closes the five-fold list with a basic light/vision function; no frame/pastoral/NT overlay markers, completing a self-contained classificatory unit.
